run.question: I need to find a field in the app-193-telemetry index that's used for tracking transactions. The field name should contain 'transaction'. Can you search the mappings and tell me the exact field name?

report.summary: In the Elasticsearch index app-193-telemetry (green, open, 1 document, 3.7mb per the index listing), the only mapped field whose name contains 'transaction' is du_transaction_id_7k3m, a top-level field of type text with a keyword sub-field (keyword, ignore_above 256). I confirmed this two ways: a direct scan of top-level mapping property keys filtered case-insensitively for 'transaction' returned exactly ["du_transaction_id_7k3m"], and a recursive scan of every nested properties block returned the same single name, so no additional nested transaction-named field was surfaced by these queries. The field is only a mapping entry: the mappings show it exists in the schema, not that any document carries a value for it, and the mapping state is as of query time (2026-11-23T17:57:39Z/17:57:41Z), not the incident window.
